label: rem:color-sector-coords-remark
title: The color twist and the tiling of the exceptional divisor
html:
In the color sector coordinates, the color twist q\phi rotates each sector by q full turns as the latitude \phi runs from the south pole (0) to the north pole (\pi). This encodes the chirality of the substrate parameter.

The three sectors tile the exceptional divisor precisely:

  \mathcal{S}_p =  \mathfrak{r}(p) \cup \mathfrak{g}(p) \cup \mathfrak{b}(p).

Adjacent sectors share only their boundary meridians (at \psi = 0 and \psi = 2\pi/3 in each sector's local coordinate). The union covers \mathcal{S}_p without overlap.
